full_details: Before the play you looked at the feast sheet and added nothing. At two you played the Duke in Two Gentlemen. At the Theatre, hardly out of the Duke's gown after Two Gentlemen, Gilbert called from the Bell. He had half the High Street, Henley Street and forty houses, and then twenty and the north end, and he did not know whether anyone was hurt. You went to Carter Lane. Hobbins put Anne's letter in your hand. The fire was Tuesday the fifteenth, about twenty houses beyond the Rother Market, and none of yours was touched. At home you read it again by candle. You said she had told you not to come, and to come for harvest, and that those were one thing said twice. You said you will go on foot. You named no road, and you have not told the company.
one_sentence: Gilbert called from the Bell with the fire, and an hour later Anne's letter said the house was safe.
title: A garbled fire, then the house safe
